entries.back_en: "Ha ha ha ha! Did you think I'd give up so easily!? It takes much more than that to get rid of Kahn! Hrrrraaaaarrrrh! Prepare yourselves!"
"You may have beaten me before, but if you think I'm the same man you fought in the past, you're in for a big surprise! Hrrraaaaarrrrh! Defend yourselves!"
"I wish I could say there's nothing to worry about, but the wind stopped. It shouldn't have happened, not here."
"Yes...Looks like we ended up exactly where we don't want to be... Blast! How could I let this happen!?"
"We've come close to an island called the Island of Fire. The sea here is said to be haunted by some kind of monster..."
"They say there's a powerful spirit that lives on the island. And it can stop the wind, or cause tidal waves. Many ships have been lost here!"
"Avatar? I can't sense anything like that..." "Says Deis."
"Humans bring sacrifice for god?"
"Um... H-hello... Are you, um, the Sea Dragon?"
"Deis is wondering if this is even one of the Endless..."
"No..It's not one of the Endless. It doesn't have the right feel." "Says Deis."
"Hom? You didn't bring sacrifice? You talk funny--you make fun of me! I kill humans!"
"When the power of the Endless increases in the world, it begins to affect creatures sensitive to their aura, like that one. They absorb part of that power and think themselves gods."
"And since "
"Deis says," "Anything affected by the aura of the Endless like that thing back on the island is nothing but trouble!"
"Even a simple rock can gain sentence and move like that if exposed to the aura of the Endless long enough."
They would lose their power,
They would lose their power,
They would lose their power,
and live out their lives as ordinary mortals.

entries.back_en: "W...Well? How do you like being so high up? Pretty scary, isn't it? You can still quit if you want!"
And so, for some time after that,
"If you want to go to the island, use the dingy. Iggy will row it for you."
